summary: agents and skills pin their model and effort, enforced by core-lint
appCreator: Helper agents (qa, planner, reviewer) and the scripted skills now run on Sonnet at a fixed effort instead of inheriting the thread's model, so a helper no longer runs on Opus by accident. Apps also default ad-hoc helpers to Sonnet.
notVerified: That a Project thread honours the frontmatter: only the live check agent-model-honoured shows it. Skill frontmatter model/effort is not covered by that check.
